description: This file defines the ListFilesTool class, a utility for listing files in a directory, with methods for executing the listing and handling partial requests. It imports modules for path handling, task management, formatting responses, and file listing services.

classes.name: ListFilesTool
classes.description: A class extending BaseTool to list files in a specified directory, supporting recursive listing and user approval.

methods.name: parseLegacy
methods.description: Parses legacy parameters to extract path and recursive options.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the file listing operation, handles user approval, and manages errors.

methods.name: handlePartial
methods.description: Handles partial listing requests, preparing and sending partial responses.
